description_en: Thyākā Bāhāḥ is located near Naka Bahī (LAL0880) to the right-hand side of the street on the way to Kvālkhu. The small courtyard of the Bāhāḥ measures 3.6 m x 3.8 m and is surrounded by residential buildings. The way to access the Bāhāḥ is not immediately obvious; one needs to pass through a shop to reach it.The courtyard is encircled by a stone plinth and a cement plastered floor. The main temple is a single storey structure built on a raised plinth that is 80 cm high. It is open to the east side, while its rear west wall is attached to the neighbouring building. The main entrance to the shrine has atoraṇaattached to its timber carved frame and is sheltered by an overhanging roof, on top of which is half-domed pinnacle. Thetoraṇadisplays images of Akṣobhya, Prajñāpāramitā and Lokeśvara. Two small niches to the south and north of the main shrine house small statues of the Buddhist deities Mañjuśrī and Padmapāṇi Lokeśvara respectively. Both niches are topped with prayer wheels. A small statue of Gaṇeśa can be found on the southern wall of the courtyard.The name of the Bāhāḥ is comes from the name of theṭola. This is an independent Bāhāḥ;it was constructed by a member of Hiraṇyavarṇa Mahāvihāra (Kvāḥ Bāhāḥ). Unlike other Bāhāḥs there is nokvāḥpāḥchẽhere. Instead, the shrine of Akṣobhya is attached to the western wall of the courtyard. Inside the sanctum, one can find a marble image of Akṣobhya sitting on two layers of lotus petals. Marble lions were placed on the both sides of the entrance. However, only the northern lion remains today (2019). Inside the courtyard, one can also find adjarmadhātujinālayacaitya(170 cm high). This was installed in 1895 (NS 1015).No inscription recording the history of the Bāhāḥ could be found.
description_ne: थ्याका टोलमा खाछेँ बाहा: (LAL0900) र नक बही (LAL0880) को बीचमा यो बाहा: रहेको छ । थ्याका टोलमा रहेकोले यो विहारलाई थ्याका बाहाः भनिएको हो । हिरण्यवर्ण महाविहार (LAL1110) का संघ-सदस्यले बनाएको यो स्वतन्त्र निजी बाहा: हो । निजी घरको मूल ढोकाबाट भित्र पसेपछि सानो चोकभित्र यो बाहा: रहेको छ । चोकको पश्चिमी भागमा बाहा:को क्वा:पा:द्य: स्थापना गरिएको छ । अन्य बाहा:मा जस्तो यहाँ क्वा:पा:छेँ बनाइएको छैन, अग्लो पेटीमाथि सानो मन्दिर मात्र बनाइएको छ । मन्दिरको छानामा वज्र प्लाष्टर गरी घण्टाकार गजुर राखिएको छ । छाना अड्याउन सादा टुँडाल प्रयोग गरिएका छन् । गर्भगृहको ढोका कलात्मक बनाइएको छ । ढोकामाथि काष्ठतोरण राखिएको छ । तोरणको बीचमा अक्षोभ्य, दायाँ धर्मको प्रतीक प्रज्ञापारमिता र बायाँ संघको प्रतीक लोकेश्वर राखिएका छन् । गर्भगृहभित्र मार्बलको अक्षोभ्य बुद्ध स्थापना गरिएको छ । दुई तहको कमलको पत्रमाथि अक्षोभ्य बुद्ध बसेका छन् । ढोकामाथि बाहिरपट्टि घण्टी झुण्ड्याइएका छन् । ढोकाको दायाँ-बायाँ मार्बलका एक जोडी सिंह राखिएकोमा दक्षिणतिरको सिंह फुटेकोले उत्तरतिरको सिंह मात्र बाँकी छ । गर्भगृहको दक्षिणमा मञ्जुश्री, उत्तरमा पद्मपाणि लोकेश्वर र बाहा:को दक्षिणी भित्तामा गणेशको मार्बलको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएका छन् । बाहा: प्राङ्गणमा नेसं १०१५ मा स्थापना गरिएको धर्मधातु जिनालाय चैत्य रहेको छ ।यो बाहा:को स्थापनाबारे कुनै अभिलेख पाइँदैन ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)
references: REFERENCES Locke, John Kerr. Buddhist Monasteries of Nepal: A Survey of the Bahas and Bahis of the Kathmandu Valley . Kathmandu: Sahayogi Press, 1985. p. 60.
